steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (*Pant, pant*...! *Pant, pant*...)

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (...A trap?! Was that attack back there just a feint?)

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (If she keeps cutting up my team, the whole unit will be worthless...)

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (I have to contact them right away!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (Grrr, why can't I move my fingers? Why am I shivering?!)

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: (I... I can't let her get me!)

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Nggah!
(Low growling).
Projekt Red, don't kill her.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: *Hack* *hack*...! Gah!
Is it her?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Yes, definitely. It's her scent.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: *Sniff sniff*

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Ick. Fake. She is no wolf.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: But the scent is real.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: The scent of a true wolf. The first true wolf.
True wolf?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You... filthy cub!

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Mmf, how can I...? My muscles won't even respond.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Can... can you control me?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: She tried to use a wolf technique, a bite she learned from wolves.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: She wants to fight back. I can sever her spine, and paralyze her.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No need for that.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Ok.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Wait, you...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I know you... I finally found you...!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Traitor... you traitor! I found the traitor!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And you are...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ilia's daughter, Lyudmila?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Shut up! You have no right to speak my father's name!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Ursus destroyed all the lab, and all the scientists.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Is that what you think?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: How dare you?!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: It was you! You're the disgusting traitor who sold out my father with Sergei, who sold out all the scientists!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your hair is the same color as his.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...What are you talking about? Why would you...?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Don't move.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Agh!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're wondering why I have no reaction to your accusations?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Because you're scum!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Scum. And what type of scum should I be?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Should I be a coward, out for wealth and luxury...? Or should I be cruel and calculating, doing whatever it takes to achieve my goals?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The me, standing here before you, does it fit your image?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I never thought... I never thought you were a heartless, cold-blooded woman!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did Sergei give you a heartfelt confession before you killed him?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...What are you...?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Did you know he was Alex and Misha's father?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hah... Hahaha...! Alex helped me find him!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Reunion took in Alex, killed his father, and hunted down his sister.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hah...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Projekt Red, let her move.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Ok.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...What do you want?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To give you a chance to kill me.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: A chance? Do you know what you're saying?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You're giving up on life? You want to repent, like Sergei, who sat on top of Chernobog after selling out his colleagues?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Oh you'll regret it. You'll regret everything you ever did!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'No regrets,' I always say...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But actually, there is one massive regret I will share with you today.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ——But I'm afraid it has nothing to do with your father.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I'll kill you. I'm going to kill you!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: *Hiss* Haah...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: 'Swallow the bitterness of the dead'...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fog?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: It's Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No, not fog... This is smoke.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The nervous system stimulates a smoke-emitting organ in the oral cavity. It is indeed an Originium Art that relies on this Infected organ.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You stand there talking your mouth off... You're beyond saving. Are you so scared you can't even show it?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why did you betray my father? Why did you betray the scientists?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why?! Tell me why——

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: 'Director Kal'tsit'?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lyudmila, I only barely made it out alive myself.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You expect me to believe your bullshit?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Hah. Your father read you 'Truth and Justice,' didn't he?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: To give a five-year-old a book like that... Ilia really had no sense.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But he loved that book. One summer day, he carried you, and the book, past the window, the bushes orange against the sun. He made you wave to me. You pouted and turned your head.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Enough!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: That night, he asked me: what if we just sealed up the sarcophagus and never told the Ursus about the machines inside? Would we be able to save more people?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Would we be able to prevent the Ursus from using these machines in battle?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Are you saying all of this to... to confuse me?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ilia was one of the scientists who came up with the plan to seal the sarcophagus. And his convictions influenced his entire life.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You have his fighting spirit. But there was more to him than that...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lyudmila, you call me a traitor, you want to kill me. You could do that, but——

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When you choose violence, you are doomed to one day meet something stronger than you.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Hah hah...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Could you be more arrogant? No one, no caster can penetrate my fog. You have no idea where I am.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: You're going to die screaming. I need you to die screaming.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...... (Sticking out her tongue).

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: For the scientists, for the infected, I have to kill you. You Ursus puppet! You piece of trash!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do I look like a caster to you? I am Infected though, you got that right...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Come, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...Huh? What... what's that?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: H- how? Your spine?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I guess you can see through the fog, huh?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: How...?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Ack...! Wh- what are you...?!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What is that?!!!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I am not a caster. I've never relied on Originium Arts.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Go, Mon3tr.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Happy hissing).

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Nnng... Gaaaagh!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: What is it?! What is that thing?!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Aaaaaah! Don't touch me! Let me go! Let go of meeee!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Why can't I pierce its shell? Aiee! Don't touch me! Get away!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Annihilate...

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Aaaaaahh!!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...the falling object above her.

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Dissatisfied hissing).

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're too excited. The building is going to collapse. Don't let her get crushed.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Mmmg......

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Low humming).

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Just kill me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...You can obviously kill me easily! Don't tell me you're the type who plays with your prey!

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If I can't kill you, what do I have to live for?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: Just remember, even if I'm dead, I've still cursed you forever!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Are you truly prepared to die?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you want to die?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If I am your traitor, will you feel better after killing me?

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: ...No more... talking! I'll kill you! I will!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ilia was my student, and my friend.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your father was one of my finest researchers. His dedication and selflessness could have pushed Ursus at least five years into the future.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: I don't want to hear anymore! Why do you insist on telling me this stuff?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You do want to hear it. Because you've always doubted yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You never let Sergei explain himself. So I'll do it for him.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ——I don't betray people. Not even Sergei.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: He was indecisive, but not greedy.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The Ursus authorities had his newborn son and daughter. He gave up your father's location to save their lives.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And now, Alex and Misha are dead. He wasn't able to save anyone, in the end.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: If... If I had gone to save Misha, maybe she and Skullshatterer... would still be alive.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: N- no! No way! Look how powerful you are! Why didn't you save my father?!

steps.name: Mon3tr
steps.text: (Threatening growling).

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Because I couldn't.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I couldn't have convinced your father to leave the institute.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Lyudmila, I sent you to Siracusa before I left Chernobog. And yet you went back.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Oh, you're so like your father. Sometimes, willpower trumps time itself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You would always return to Chernobog, just like you would meet me here.

steps.name: Crownslayer
steps.text: So this is all meaningless? Everything my father did, everything I did... was for nothing?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: No. The researchers died to protect our secret.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ursus to this day has no way to analyze the contents of the sarcophagus. They've given up, and sealed off the installation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now, there's just a little energy left to harness, powering the core of Chernobog.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If I betrayed anyone, it's the Empire of Ursus.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Your father's efforts meant something. Even if Ursus has long since covered it all up, you can remember.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I will remember.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Yawn).

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...But all that you did? What was that for?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Ursus purged the entire institute and slaughtered every scrap of compassion in any of their scientists. The real traitor was the Empire itself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Look at you. You've killed Sergei, you've killed a man who couldn't protect his own children.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Now you're in Lungmen. If you and your Infected friends really manage to take over the city, what will you do to the uninfected?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Massacre them all? Enslave them? Exile them to the wilderness and let them die of exposure?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Or cut them all with Originium, turn them into Infected, spread your pain to them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...Or will you peacefully coexist with them?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Could you do that, Lyudmila? Could Reunion, as it is now, do that? Is that how you want to build your Infected nation? Or is that how you want to fight Ursus?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If the latter, why come to Lungmen? If you seek to terrify your enemies, what can you do to be more terrifying than Ursus?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: (Kal'tsit, she is confused. She is scared. She wants to run.)

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Mon3tr, return.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Is that okay?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She can hear me.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Crownslayer,' your hate as well as that of your movement has been used and abused, toyed with.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Think of your father. Remember what Ilia taught you.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Think, on whom do you want revenge?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: The one leading you down this path of terror and assassination... Your leader is not a sane person. Your leader has no heart.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A leader true to her ideals would not let someone else die for them, much less let someone commit murder on their behalf.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Run. Leave this place. Take a different path.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Take a path that can truly change this world... If that's what you want.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Her scent is gone.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Did you always want to see her? Why not kill her?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Should we kill a homeless hyena, even if the home isn't real?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: A hard question. I don't know.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Projekt Red, do you think killing me would make her happy?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: No. She is in pain.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: We are not the law. We cannot judge people. We have the power to kill others, but no power to claim it is right to do so.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: If she took pleasure in the act of murder, I would have killed her on the spot. Without question.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I know. She is not happy. Her breathing is erratic.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: She has now become a virus. A unique strain spreading 'unease' among the Infected fanatics of Chernobog.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...How many years does a person live? And how many paths can they take? We spend more time blind than we do seeing the truth.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: But then, seeing the truth and making a choice are two different things.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: When she awakens from this dream of collective revenge, she will leave Reunion. But even so, Sergei's blood, and that of the people of Chernobog, will always be on her hands.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Projekt Red... When you make a choice, there is no going back.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I understand. I will do my best. I will only kill wolves.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Good girl.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Do you remember that scent?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: I remember.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: What is it like?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: ...Not bad.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: It's a bloody smell, but not like you were just saying, with the heart and stuff.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: How silly. Talulah is a Draco, how could she be a wolf?

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Hmm.

steps.name: Projekt Red
steps.text: Time to go?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Yes, let's go.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: ...The temperature's dropping. We're running out of time. Let's step up our efficiency.
